docs: Real-application browser journey plan for the existing scripts/review/journey.mjs harness (drives a real Chromium session against a running panel/devstack), not a component fixture. This session validated the plan structurally (JSON/selector contract and knowledge-lint); it did not run this plan against a live disposable panel because this checkout pins Playwright 1.61.0 with no local driver/browser and no install/build was permitted. PR CI for this head does not invoke this plan: its packaged-route fixture (scripts/manual-review/e2e/a11y-check.mjs) has no /modpacks route. Representative real-execution evidence comes from the exact showcase CI artifact (run 44651279419, Playwright 1.61.0, seeded disposable stack): report.md PASS with 'modpacks loads' and 'first modpack card renders', and showcase-modpacks.png showing the same shell controls asserted here. That artifact executed plan-showcase.json, not this plan. The explicit refusal case here types an unmatched modpack query, asserts the 'No modpacks matching' empty state, then clicks 'Clear search & filters' and asserts the populated card returns: a public-seam refusal/reconciliation requiring no world or credential change. Asserts stable /modpacks library shell controls plus that one non-mutating search state; does not claim indexer/catalog correctness, import/upload mutations, or permission variants.
